timing.recurrence: Annually through the monsoon weeks, typically late July into August; organised by Gujarat Tourism

description: Gujarat Tourism's flagship hill-station event: a weeks-long programme of cultural performances, Dangi dance, food stalls, adventure activities and parades staged around Saputara's lakefront while the plateau does its best monsoon impression — mist over the lake, waterfalls at full volume nearby, and everything green. Weekends carry the main programming. It is the busiest the town gets outside Diwali; the flip side is that monsoon Saputara with a festival layered on is genuinely at its most atmospheric.
crowd_impact: Festival weekends sell out Saputara's hotels; book weeks ahead and expect slow ghat traffic on Sunday evenings.
tips: Weekends for the programme, weekdays for the atmosphere without crowds
Pair festival days with Gira Falls at peak flow, 50 km down the ghat
Carry rain gear you can walk in — umbrellas lose to ghat wind
